bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet as of Jun-26: total equity ₹46,237cr, networth ₹47,440cr, total borrowings ₹2,45,487cr and total borrowings to total equity ratio of 5.3x (down from 6.3x in Q4FY24), with total assets of ₹3,01,714cr.
- Capital adequacy well above the 15% regulatory CRAR: Total CRAR 18.5% and Tier-I 15.6% in Q1FY27 (TCL standalone), with Tier-II at 2.9%.
- Liquidity buffer of ₹29,039cr as of Jun-26 on consolidated basis.
- Capital deployed into growth via the all-cash Yogloans acquisition (pre-money equity value not exceeding ₹318 Cr plus ~₹93 Cr primary infusion) rather than any dividend action discussed in the deck.
- Funding mix as of Jun'26 across NHB, bank loans, ECB/MTN, NCD, Tier II/perpetual and CP/WCDL; the deck emphasises diversified liabilities as a source of lower cost of funds.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "3rd largest diversified NBFC in India with a comprehensive product suite" (source: CRISIL Report; based on total gross loans as of Jun 30, 2025), with the "Tata" brand name listed as a key strength.
- Tata Capital Limited is an upper layer NBFC with a 100% owned housing finance subsidiary (TCHFL, 100%); Tata Sons holds 78.8%. Net AUM ~₹2.9tn as of Jun 30, 2026, with Retail & SME forming 85.4% of Net AUM.
- Key strengths cited: omni-channel "Phygital" model; prudent risk culture and strong underwriting; highest credit rating and diversified liabilities ensuring lower cost of funds; digital, GenAI and analytics at the core; management team with combined experience of over 400 years.
- "Strong track record with 18 years of profitability"; journey milestones include commencing lending in 2007, crossing ₹2tn loan book, domestic rating upgrade from AA+ to AAA (by CRISIL), international BBB- rating by S&P and Fitch, and successful listing on NSE and BSE in Oct-25.
- TCHFL described as "one of the largest HFCs with best-in-class return profile" and "among the top originators in Affordable Home Loans".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Merger] Tata Capital Limited completed its merger with Tata Motors Finance Limited (TMFL) in May-25 with an appointed date of Apr 1, 2024; the merger became effective on May 8, 2025 and Q1FY26 is the first quarter of combined operations. TCFSL and TCCL were earlier merged into TCL.
- [Listing] Successfully listed on NSE and BSE in Oct-25 (BSE scrip code 544574, NSE symbol TATACAP).
- [AI] Enterprise AI build-out described as "Scaling AI from individual use cases to enterprise-wide business transformation": 12,000+ employees trained, 100% mid and senior management coverage, 9,000+ AI-assisted interviews in regional languages, ~4 Cr documents processed through AI till Jun-26, 110+ document formats trained, 90%+ AI adoption across PL and BL underwriting, 70% of retail applications processed via AI, 90% of welcome calls through AI, 95%+ pre-delinquency calls handled through AI-assisted bots.
- [Group structure] Subsidiaries include Tata Securities Ltd. (distributes mutual funds and other financial products, 100%), Tata Capital Pte. Ltd. Singapore (fund management, 100%) and Tata Capital Housing Finance Ltd. (housing finance, 100%), plus step-down subsidiaries operating the domestic private equity business.
- [TCHFL portfolio] TCHFL Q1FY27 Net AUM of ₹89,416cr split across Prime & Near Prime HL ₹36,035cr, Prime LAP ₹18,501cr, DF ₹17,591cr, AHF ₹17,606cr and MH ₹1,185 Cr; sourcing mix 61% direct and 39% DSA; home loan salaried:self-employed mix 50%:50%; ATS ₹32 lakh for Retail and ₹79 Cr for Developer Finance.

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Tata Capital as the "3rd largest diversified NBFC in India" — an upper-layer NBFC with a 100% owned housing finance subsidiary, a Retail/SME-dominated ~₹2.9tn Net AUM book, a pan-India "Phygital" distribution model and a self-described "digital-first"/AI-first operating stack, backed by the Tata brand and the highest domestic credit rating.
